title: Like Football Manager, but for a chess player. Looking for beta testers
author: Kryzpk
selftext:
Hello there,

I love playing chess, and I always had a thing for football manager games or other browser games so I decided to create a chess manager game.

It's not as complex as some other games here but I hope it's appreciated nontheless :) AI supported mainly with the system design as I am not using vercel to host but rented a vserver so setting that all up was a first and AI was quite helpful! 

**How does it work?!**

You get a 12-year-old chess player with a low rating and manage them throughout their whole career. Similar to football managers, you pick their training, the openings they learn and play, how they prep for the next opponent, etc. The games are played automatically based on your Elo, strategy and opening preparation. You can watch the game live as it's being played.

The idea is to have a weekly league against other real players. Like in other manager games, you can spend as much or as little time as you want. A couple of minutes per day? Fine.

I've opened beta registration and I'm looking for people who want to test it early and give some feedback. Any chess lovers here? Would love to connect. See you on the board! :D

Sign-up and Discord: [https://leagueofchess.com/?ref=rd-sim](https://leagueofchess.com/?ref=rd-sim)

comments.author: LowerMiddleClassMan
comments.body:
Football managers appeal is in the international leagues, youth intake, euro competitions, “country” saves where you try to build up their euro competition score and turn a Gibraltar or Wales into a powerhouse with teams winning across the Champions League, Euro conference, etc.

This does not capture this at all.

Your better bet would be to make it tuned towards people who like a single player career more like MyCareer on NBA2K.

You can obviously get chess fans to, just trying to call out the pull of FM, as a huge fan, has nothing to do with one single player and you won’t capture that audience.  Even for youth intake, I care about a golden generation that will help my entire club trajectory, not just a specific ST or CB.

replies.author: Kryzpk
replies.body:
Hey, appreciate the feedback! I will try to translate the interesting bits of a football manager to the chess manager game but at the end of the day chess a solo journey (more or less). The equivalent fantasy here is the individual one: a junior rated 800 climbing from Nothing to earn a GM norm and compete in Olympiad, World Chess Championship etc. 

Some of what you listed does map, just onto a player rather than a club. Everyone picks a nationality and belongs to a federation, and federations field national teams for a biennial Olympiad. The world renews itself like FM's regens: AI players age and retire.

  
Clubs exist too with contracts, transfers and weekend team matches, though you play for one rather than run one. Above the weekly league seasons there are open tournaments and invitationals, and further up a championship cycle with finals that eventually bring different worlds together. The league and tournaments are planned for the beta.

I don't know if this project will work out but I built something I wanted to play myself for a long time and hope to catch some interest :) 

But overall you are right as team sport like football is a better pick for a manager game. Cheers

replies.author: LowerMiddleClassMan
replies.body: I think there’s a lot of potential there now that you elaborated.
